<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">

    <rect x="382" y="15" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#09121F"/>

  <g aria-label="header">
    <circle cx="31" cy="65" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#162A48" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="65" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#162A48" stroke-width="2"/>

    <line x1="24" y1="91" x2="366" y2="91" stroke="#E5E7EB" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <text x="31" y="137" font-family="Open Sans, PingFang SC, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="700" fill="#162A48">
    <tspan x="31" dy="0">欢迎登录</tspan>
    <tspan x="31" dy="25" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#909EB0">连接您的 Audi，开启智能出行</tspan>
  </text>

  <g aria-label="phone field">
    <text x="31" y="207" font-family="Open Sans, PingFang SC, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#646668">手机号码</text>
    <rect x="31" y="218" width="328" height="56" rx="10" fill="#FAFAFA" stroke="#E1E1E1"/>
    <text x="48" y="252" font-family="PingFang SC, Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">请输入手机号码</text>
    <line x1="91" y1="235" x2="91" y2="257" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="48" y="251" font-family="PingFang SC, Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#646668">+86</text>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="verification code field">
    <text x="31" y="304" font-family="Open Sans, PingFang SC, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#646668">验证码</text>
    <rect x="31" y="315" width="328" height="56" rx="10" fill="#FAFAFA" stroke="#E1E1E1"/>
    <text x="48" y="349" font-family="PingFang SC, Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">请输入验证码</text>
    <line x1="253" y1="328" x2="253" y2="358" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <rect x="267" y="327" width="78" height="32" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4475F2"/>
      <text x="306" y="348" text-anchor="middle" font-family="PingFang SC, Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#4475F2">获取验证码</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="agreement">
    <rect x="31" y="397" width="17" height="17" rx="3" fill="#4475F2"/>
    <polyline points="35,405 39,409 45,402" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="57" y="410" font-family="PingFang SC, Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646668">
      <tspan>我已阅读并同意</tspan><tspan fill="#4475F2">《用户协议》</tspan><tspan>与</tspan><tspan fill="#4475F2">《隐私政策》</tspan>
    </text>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="primary login button">
    <rect x="32" y="440" width="328" height="56" rx="10" fill="#0000000A"/>
    <rect x="31" y="438" width="328" height="56" rx="10" fill="#4475F2" stroke="#4475F2"/>
    <text x="195" y="472" text-anchor="middle" font-family="PingFang SC, Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">登录</text>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="530" text-anchor="middle" font-family="PingFang SC, Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#909EB0">
    <tspan>或使用其他方式登录</tspan>
  </text>
  <line x1="31" y1="525" x2="132" y2="525" stroke="#E1E1E1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="258" y1="525" x2="359" y2="525" stroke="#E1E1E1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <g aria-label="Apple login">
    <rect x="31" y="552" width="158" height="50" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA"/>
    <path d="M110 568 C106 568 104 571 101 571 C98 571 96 568 92 568 C87 568 84 572 84 578 C84 584 88 593 92 593 C95 593 96 591 100 591 C104 591 105 593 108 593 C112 593 116 584 116 579 C116 573 113 568 110 568Z" fill="#09121F"/>
    <path d="M106 565 C108 563 108 560 108 559 C105 559 102 561 101 563 C100 564 100 566 100 566 C102 566 105 566 106 565Z" fill="#09121F"/>
    <text x="143" y="582" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#09121F">Apple</text>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="Google login">
    <rect x="201" y="552" width="158" height="50" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA"/>
    <path d="M233 566 A10 10 0 1 0 233 588" fill="none" stroke="#4285F4" stroke-width="4"/>
    <path d="M233 566 A10 10 0 0 1 242 570" fill="none" stroke="#EA4335" stroke-width="4"/>
    <path d="M233 588 A10 10 0 0 1 242 584" fill="none" stroke="#34A853" stroke-width="4"/>
    <path d="M242 570 L247 570 L247 578 L237 578" fill="none" stroke="#FBBC05" stroke-width="4"/>
    <text x="299" y="582" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#09121F">Google</text>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="security note">
    <circle cx="43" cy="643" r="10" fill="#F5F8FA"/>
    <rect x="39" y="641" width="8" height="8" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#909EB0" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <path d="M41 641 C41 637 45 637 45 641" fill="none" stroke="#909EB0" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="62" y="648" font-family="PingFang SC, Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#909EB0">
      <tspan>登录即享受车辆远程控制、充电状态查询等服务</tspan>
    </text>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="bottom navigation">
    <rect x="0" y="754" width="390" height="90" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

      <polygon points="49,775 60,766 71,775 71,787 64,787 64,779 56,779 56,787 49,787" fill="#4475F2"/>

    </g>

    </g>

    <g>
      <circle cx="321" cy="773" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#AEB9CA" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="321" cy="787" rx="12" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#AEB9CA" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="321" y="808" text-anchor="middle" font-family="PingFang SC, Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#909EB0">我的</text>
    </g>
